fun_facts: Arch Manning grew up in New Orleans and went to Ole Miss and LSU football games as a kid.
He played flag football in fifth grade.
At Isidore Newman, he was a four-year starter and threw for 8,599 yards and 115 touchdowns, while also rushing for 1,155 yards and 25 touchdowns.
He broke his high school’s records for passing yards and passing touchdowns.
In 2026, he threw a 4-yard touchdown pass with 3 seconds left to help Texas beat LSU, 22–21.
